# Twins Consulting Group (TCG)

> PT Twins Consulting Group is a property consultancy based in Kuta, Bali, Indonesia. It audits completed and stalled properties in Bali for legal and technical issues, advises landowners in Indonesia on land monetization, and is developing a property intelligence platform.

## Services

- [Property Compliance Audit](https://twinsconsulting.group/services/property-legal-audit): For completed villas, apartments and developments in Bali. Identifies what prevents the property from operating legally (land rights, zoning, PBG/SLF, licensing) and defines the actions required. From US$2,500.
- [Distressed Property Audit](https://twinsconsulting.group/services/distressed-property): For stalled, unfinished or problematic property projects in Bali. Legal review, technical inspection, recovery costs and value assessment to decide whether to complete, restructure or sell. From US$5,000.
- [Land Monetization Strategy](https://twinsconsulting.group/land): For landowners in Indonesia considering sale, subdivision, development or investor positioning.

## Platform

- [Property Intelligence Platform](https://twinsconsulting.group/platform): In development, target launch Q2 2027. Not currently operational.

## Guide

- [Bali Villa Regulations 2026](https://twinsconsulting.group/regulations): Source-based guide to Bali villa legality: zoning, PBG, SLF, NIB, KBLI, OSS, PT PMA and the compliance path for existing villas.
